summary: Fully read both lessons/quizzes; corrected registry immutability, tag/CLI syntax, runtime mirrors, lifecycle logic, image promotion, costs/DR, signing/admission, node image-pull network identity, CI gates and Skopeo transport.
findings: Version tags alone are mutable; Docker Hub now supports immutable tags in Beta; Harbor content trust is not tag immutability
docker tag accepts one target and SemVer +build is not legal tag syntax
ECR tagPatternList uses AND; separate prefix rules and protect deployed digests
RTO/RPO and cost thresholds were presented as guarantees without evidence
Node build omitted devDependencies before compilation; old Node20 line was EOL
GitHub Actions scan target mismatched generated short tags and could run after publication
GitLab scan lacked registry auth/entrypoint and publish did not prove same artifact; replaced with gated tar artifact flow
NetworkPolicy on application Pods does not control kubelet/containerd image pulls
Skopeo regex list should be scalar; bulk sync unbounded; all-platform copy and path/auth prerequisites missing
validation: 59 Markdown fences parsed; nested GitHub Actions Bash checked
Official actionlint 1.7.12 checksum verified; revised workflow passed static validation
Action input names and commit pins compared against official versioned sources
Docker base tags and supported Node24 release line verified against official images/Release schedule
Cloud/registry/CI jobs were not executed; credentials/resources remain documented prerequisites
